title: The Plan pop-up is split into Overview, To-dos, Talk and History, and names its owner

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: one max-w-lg dialog holds about 12 blocks (summary, manifest fields, repeats, to-dos, Find a time, event repair, sharing, comments, activity, archive). The owner reads 'Assigned teammate' instead of a name, and every Plan is subtitled '<kind> production record' even at Pencil. Builds on LIVE-2544 (one line per to-do, PR #5499). Fix: four tabs; Overview carries stage, owner by name, dates and readiness; Find a time shows only when the Plan has two or more candidate dates; sharing sits behind one Share button; the subtitle drops 'production record' before Production.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
